newsitem.title: UK: Analysts see CWC trading at around 300p/shr.
newsitem.headline: Analysts see CWC trading at around 300p/shr.

text.p: Most analysts expect Cable and Wireless Communications to start trade at around 300 pence per share in London and $15.0 in New York to value the company at around 4.5 billion pounds.

The company, which will float 14.7 percent of its 1.489 billion shares at 1330 GMT today to coincide with the New York market open, will be the new, but relatively small rival to British Telecommunications Plc.
CWC was formed last year by merging Cable and Wireless Plc's Mercury unit with three cable television companies -- NYNEX CableComms Group, Bell Cablemedia Plc and Videotron.
BT's current market capitalisation is around 28 billion pounds.
